annotations.title: Dialogue to audio: a script with several speakers as one MP3, plus captions

description:
Turn a script into a multi-voice conversation: write one line per turn as "Name: text", each speaker gets their own natural voice (Deepgram Aura-2, English or Spanish, or pick voices), and the whole dialogue comes back as one MP3 with SRT captions naming the speaker, timed from the real audio. Up to 6 speakers and 2,500 characters. Use for podcast intros, language-lesson dialogues, explainer videos, ads and game or story scenes. Example: script=Anna: Welcome back to the show!
Ben: Thanks, it is great to be here.. Price $0.10/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

script.description: One turn per line as Name: text (up to 6 speakers, 2,500 characters)

voices.description: Voice per speaker, as JSON {"Anna":"luna"} or Anna=luna, Ben=orion (default: a different voice each, in order)
